title: +CAREER SKILLS IN FISHERIES, WILDLIFE, AND CONSERVATION SCIENCES
description: Develops and practices the skills needed to search, apply, and attain internships and jobs in fisheries, wildlife, and conservation sciences. Focuses on building a career-ready resume and cover letter, mock interview practice, attendance and reflection of a career-relevant event, and a personalized plan for their career advancement.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: FW 107 and (CORE 100, 300, LA 100, 300, SCI 100, 300, BA 100, 300, ED 100, 300, ENGR 110, 110H, 310 or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student').
A minimum grade of P is required in FW 107.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100, SCI 300, BA 100, BA 300, ED 100, ED 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H and ENGR 310.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Fish, Wildlife & Conserv Scien (018) or Fisheries & Wildlife Sciences (733).

Enrollment limited to students in the Oregon State - Corvallis campus.
